pack_name: KYE Publishing Authority Track Reference Pack

claim_set.claim_text: Every claim in a co-authored governed edition resolves to a cited public source pinned into the sealed evidence pack (the §62 Veracity / §13 no-hallucination rule).
Each published edition is a kye.research_report.v1 instance sealed with Ed25519 over the published JWKS, verifiable from public keys alone with no vendor cooperation.
A governed edition renders once to web, email, and PDF through the canonical deterministic-render machinery; the Track ships no parallel renderer (§0).
The Pack represents KYE as governing the provenance and authority of a research action, never the outcome it asserts — KYE governs actions and authorities, not outcomes, diagnoses, or results.

Co-authoring is limited to strong research participants in scope of §62 (university, research institute, lab, think-tank, standards body, academic press); games and trade-book publishing are out of scope.
